title: Futuristic AI Dance Video - Rhythm - Kelly Boesch | 4K
description:
Another dance video for Friday. "Rhythm"  is the song. A little strange future vibe. Images made using #Midjourney and animated using #VEO3. Song made using ​⁠@suno  

#ai #aiart #aivideo #aimusic #suno #aiimages #googleveo3 #surreal
